 BUTTS COUNTY, Ga (WGXA) — A lucky Georgia Lottery player in Butts County is celebrating after matching all five winning numbers to hit a $621,715 jackpot in Thursday's Fantasy 5 drawing.
 According to the Georgia Lottery, the ticket was purchased at Stark Suprette, located at 900 Stark Road in Jackson.

 The player matched all five winning numbers, which were 10-20-21-26-35.
 As with all Georgia Lottery games, proceeds from Fantasy 5, Diggi Games and Millionaire for Life benefit education in the state of Georgia, per the Georgia Lottery.
